mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_inventory_batch ( batch_no, product_id, purchase_id, purchase_item_id, purchase_date, unit_cost, initial_quantity, available_quantity, sold_quantity, locked_quantity, status, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{batchNo}, #{productId}, #{purchaseId}, #{purchaseItemId}, #{purchaseDate}, #{unitCost}, #{initialQuantity}, #{availableQuantity}, #{soldQuantity}, #{lockedQuantity}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.product_type_id, pt.type_name AS product_type_name, p.brand, p.model, p.specification, p.warning_stock, COALESCE(SUM(b.initial_quantity), 0) AS initial_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(b.available_quantity), 0) AS available_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(b.locked_quantity), 0) AS locked_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(b.sold_quantity), 0) AS sold_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(b.available_quantity * b.unit_cost), 0) AS stock_amount FROM biz_product p LEFT JOIN biz_product_type pt ON pt.id = p.product_type_id AND pt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_inventory_batch b ON b.product_id = p.id AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND (p.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.product_type_id IN
#{typeId}
AND p.product_type_id = #{productTypeId}
GROUP BY p.id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.product_type_id, pt.type_name, p.brand, p.model, p.specification, p.warning_stock
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(b.available_quantity), 0) <= p.warning_stock
ORDER BY available_quantity ASC, p.id DESC

SELECT b.id AS batchId, b.batch_no AS batchNo, b.product_id AS productId, p.product_code AS productCode, p.product_name AS productName, pt.type_name AS productTypeName, p.brand, p.model, p.specification, b.purchase_id AS purchaseId, b.purchase_item_id AS purchaseItemId, pu.purchase_no AS purchaseNo, pu.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, pu.platform, pu.platform_order_no AS platformOrderNo, pu.seller_account AS sellerAccount, pi.device_no AS deviceNo, pi.condition_desc AS conditionDesc, b.available_quantity AS availableQuantity, b.unit_cost AS unitCost, p.default_sale_price AS defaultSalePrice FROM biz_inventory_batch b INNER JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = b.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_product_type pt ON pt.id = p.product_type_id AND pt.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN biz_purchase pu ON pu.id = b.purchase_id AND pu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_purchase_item pi ON pi.id = b.purchase_item_id AND pi.deleted = 0 WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1 AND b.available_quantity > 0
AND (p.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pu.purchase_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pu.platform_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pi.device_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.product_type_id IN
#{typeId}
ORDER BY pu.purchase_date ASC, b.id ASC
SELECT * FROM biz_inventory_batch WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_inventory_batch SET available_quantity = available_quantity - #{quantity}, sold_quantity = sold_quantity + #{quantity}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND available_quantity >= #{quantity}
UPDATE biz_inventory_batch SET purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE purchase_id = #{purchaseId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE biz_inventory_batch SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE purchase_id = #{purchaseId} AND sold_quantity = 0 AND locked_quantity = 0 AND deleted = 0
